'''Bounce''' was a game that could be found in [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] which involved [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and moving targets within an enclosed room. Unlike traditional target shooting, direct hits on the targets didn't count, only hits to the targets that were reflected or "bounced" off the enclosure's walls.<ref name="GSWU" /> Bounce was available to play at the casino in the [[Aspre Plunge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]].<ref name="SR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref>
